snippet.title: Probability Comparison: 2020 Events
snippet.description:
From Kobe Bryant to US Elections, Among Us to Cyberpunk 2077, Paradise to Tiger King, we compare the most viral and trending topics of 2020 and what are the odds you have searched for this event. We list the most popular events that shaped 2020 that many of us remember, but how many of you actually experienced them, what is the probability, that is 1 in how many of you all actually searched for them? 

Music used: In Dreams by Scott Buckley (CC4.0), https://www.scottbuckley.com.au/library/in-dreams/ 

Sources: Google Trends & Semrush Keywords Analytics. 

Disclaimer: The 1 in XYZ searches for in 2020 refers to the global searches divided by the human population and is only a rough estimate for the number who searched for the particular event. 2020 Search Volume is the total number of searches worldwide for the keywords and associated keywords for the year 2020, up to mid December only. Statistics may contain wide error margins.

snippet.title: Real Borders of Asia???🇨🇳🤯
snippet.description:
#Asia #Asiageography #Asiainnerborders #AsiaBorders #SouthAsia #EastAsia #southeastasia #CentralAsia #Continents #Europe #Europeborders #EasternEurope #WesternEurope #Nordics #asiancountries #Indonesia #Philippines #malaysia #Thailand #EuropeanCountries #Germany #unitedkingdom #Switzerland #Austria #czechia  #poland #Russia #Filnand  #comparison #facts #geography #geopolitics #population #gdp #military #maps 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
So we know these are the inner boundaries of Europe, but what are the inner boundaries of Asia.
Firstly Asias richest region East Asia includes Japan and all these other really smart countries, while south of it is Southeast Asia containing countries like Indonesia Malaysia and Thailand.
Asias north only has Siberia so we dont use the term North Asia, while South Asia contains all these countries in the subcontinent.
Central Asia has these Turkic countries and Tajikistan, while West Asia also doesn’t exist as it’s usually just called the Middle East.

snippet.title: Europe is losing a country???🇪🇺😳
snippet.description:
#Europe #europegeography  #Belgium #BelgiumGeograhy #Flanders #Wallonia #EuropeFacts #EuropeanCountries #Netherlands #NetherlandsGeography #Germany #unitedkingdom #Switzerland #Austria #czechia  #poland #Russia #Filnand  #comparison #facts #geography #geopolitics #maps 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
This European country could disappear in the future.
